name: GPT Project Brief
description: Read-only on-demand Git and task briefs for a startup-bound repository.
instructions: Call project_brief for fresh JSON evidence or project_brief_export for fresh Markdown text. Optional filter: all, changes, open, blocked. Workspace is fixed at startup; do not send root/path/workspace arguments. Preserve warnings and errors. Do not infer test results or causes of blockers. Select the GPT Project Brief server by its gpt-project-brief identity when another package has similarly named tools.
